result.note: Tests the phasing in the March 2026 assembly election schedule, the one structural detail that sets one state apart.

questions.prompt: In March 2026, the Election Commission of India announced assembly elections in five states and Union Territories. Which of the following was scheduled to vote in two phases?
questions.explain: West Bengal was the only one of the five to vote in two phases, on April 23 and 29. Assam, Kerala and Puducherry voted on April 9 and Tamil Nadu on April 23. Counting for all five was set for May 4, and the Model Code of Conduct took effect on announcement.
questions.source: Assam, Kerala, and Puducherry vote on April 9; Tamil Nadu on April 23; West Bengal in two phases on April 23 and 29.
